$comment: Presentation registry of the MaxBLD lot report v2: everything a field with source `presentation:<key>` reads (labels, plain-words maps, formats, states, illustrations, Street View block, ad placements). Not lot data. Checked both ways by scripts/analysis/report-schema.mjs RS-4 (every key referenced by report-v2.decl.json, every reference resolves). Rulings cited by Q-id from scripts/surfaces/_schema/report-v2.rulings.json.

display_label.note: card titles by scenario code; {dwelling_units} filled from the card (H is 4 or 6, gap 1)

trust_label.precedent_estimate: Precedent estimate (Committee of Adjustment), not law

status_text.not_buildable: Allowed, but nothing fits on this lot as of right.
status_text.not_applicable: Does not apply to this lot.
status_text.not_evaluated:exception_not_authored: A site-specific exception applies; not yet evaluated.
status_text.not_evaluated:no_existing_house: There is no existing house on this lot to renovate.
status_text.not_evaluated:needs_user_input:existing_: Enter the number of storeys of your house to see this result.
status_text.not_evaluated:needs_user_input:semi_lot: This lot looks like half of a semi-detached house. Enter your house details to see renovation options.
status_text.not_evaluated:coa_factor_unfitted: Not enough past Committee of Adjustment builds of this form to estimate.
status_text.not_evaluated:coa_factor_unfitted:suite: Not enough past Committee of Adjustment rear-suite builds to estimate (Q-4: calibrating).

field_trust.note: emitted per lineage field by the generator into the JSON Schema; never hand-listed

disclosure_texts.note: code → {template, slots, importance, mandatory} parsed from Spec 78 P5.12 by the generator; filled server-side from disclosure_params

area_unit.note: today the screen mixes formatSqm (lot) and formatSqft (GFA), [parcelId].tsx:128-130

states.semi_needs_input: This lot looks like half of a semi-detached house. Tell us about your house to see what you can add.
states.semi_correction: This isn't a semi — it's detached
states.note: Spec 78 §6.6 rules 1, 5, 8: hidden states are counted, never shown as cards; null renders "—", never 0 or "no"

lot_form_rules.note: O-12: the pipeline never reads the override; the app applies it through the P5.7 shared pure function

comparable_family_by_scenario.note: Q-5 (decided): same-form comparables are a read-time filter of parcel.neighbourhood.comparableBuilds by structure_family (values from scripts/lib/build-norms.js:72-80: detached · townhouse · multiplex; semis group as detached). No new stored field (LC-51 holds).

ad_placements.targeting_excludes: user identity (targeting runs server-side on the lot / scenario context only)
ad_placements.note: Q-7 (decided; operator: "This will be targeted ads from us"): first-party targeted ads, a separate top-level offers[] list, never inside parcel.* (Spec 100 §2.1). Q-8 (decided): two slots — after the scenario cards (detail_footer) and in the renovation section; never inside a card; always labelled Sponsored. Placement home is the placements table (Spec 128 R-34 (i)); this list is what projects into it. Disclosure: Spec 128 R-17 (FAIL) + R-34 (ii) blocking.

street_view.owed: re-check Google Maps Platform current pricing and terms before a spec cites them (the only analysis is archived Spec 74:164-176)
street_view.caption: Street View photo — illustrative only
rules: fetched server-side: panorama metadata lookup nearest the centroid, heading = bearing pano → lot, signed URL
never store image bytes (cache pano_id only)
always show attribution and imagery date; never crop the in-image logo
never used as a data input (storeys are owner input only, O-13)

illustrations.per_card: all assets with the card key, in view order (a small carousel)
illustrations.note: Q-10 (decided; operator: "Each scenario shown will have a few different photos with it"): several static illustrations per card. No new-build or suite variant on a semi_half lot (Q-1/Q-3 decided): those cards are never shown there; renovation diagrams keep a semi variant. file: null = not drawn yet
